title.narrative: Plastics Circular Investment Initiative in Indonesia

description.narrative: In Indonesia,the National Plastic Action Plan Partnership marks a significant government effort to integrate circular economy principles in plastics sector. Collaborations with entities like KOICA, ADB, and ALBA Group demonstrate the PPPs potential in developing sustainable value chains and enhancing global investment opportunities with the private sector, which must meet strict sustainability standards.Challenges include uncertainties in collection efficiency, quality of recycled plastics, long-term commitments from off-takers, and the credibility of recyclers. Digital platforms like CleanHub and Oylstable show potential in linking waste plastic recyclers with off-takers through tracking and transactions. Understanding regional actors and engaging multiple stakeholders are vital for scaling digital-assisted plastics circularity projects.This project aims to develop the digital-enhanced plastics recycling investment ecosystem with four main outputs:Output 1: Scoping Analysis and Demand Aggregation Plan Development- Focuses on evaluating digital solutions for sustainable plastic transactions, identifying potential off-takers, surveying pilot project sites, and establishing an open call scheme. Includes forming a Plastic Circularity Investment Alliance to support pilot scaling.Output 2: Scheme Announce and Proposal Evaluation- Involves announcing the scheme, engaging stakeholders to align with local priorities, and setting up a proposal evaluation process to select impactful pilots.Output 3: Pilot Project Implementation and Support Mechanisms Development- Centers on implementing and monitoring pilot projects, documenting lessons, and proposing financial mechanisms for scalability.Output 4: Design Investment Models for Plastics Sustainability Projects- Aims to select pilot projects for scale-up funding by identifying funding sources and developing comprehensive proposals to highlight the project's benefits and investment needs.
